description: Triggers a budget check every hour
Fetches recent spend across all workflows (RailCall capability NOT confirmed
Records each spend in the internal ledger (pure logic)
Decides whether the budget was exceeded and which workflows should be paused (pure logic — never itself)
Publishes the budget status to Slack
Pauses the workflows that exceeded the budget (RailCall capability NOT confirmed — this is the gap the original diagnosis flagged)
Generates the signed audit receipt for all actions taken
